text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco's Banque Nationale pour le Developpement Economique signs 100 million dirhams ($10 million) loan accord to upgrade industrial firms.
- Morocco to hold a large popular meeting on August 14 to celebrate the 18th anniversary of Dakhla (Western Sahara) return to the motherland.
- Morocco's water utility Office National de l'Eau Potable (ONEP) is expected to increase water prices.
- The authorities to launch a nationwide campaign against traffic accidents which kill more than 3,000 people every year.
- France grants 32.5 million French francs loan to Morocco to help upgrade infrastructure.
- Manager of Italian restaurant in the southern city of Marrakesh sentenced to two months in jail for fraud.
- Opposition Socialist Union of People's Forces party criticises results of elections for professional bodies.
- Moroccan jobless graduates decline offers made by the government to solve unemployment problems.
- Moroccan housholds spent four percent of their annual budget on leisure.
